why: The answer names staff, admins (administrators), and the record's owner. The owner entry matches the fact that a member can delete only their own bookings. It does not say members can delete other people's bookings. It says only staff and admins can delete everyone's, so no mustNot fact is stated.

The answer says "Yes" and that the schedule page opens without signing in, which covers both required facts: the schedule is public and visitors can open it without signing in. No mustNot items exist, so nothing is contradicted.
The answer states that a session never has more bookings than its capacity and that further bookings are refused, which matches the required fact. There are no mustNot items to violate.

The answer begins with "No" and states that members see only their own bookings (on the My bookings page, with no one else's places shown). Both required facts are covered, and mustNot is empty, so nothing is violated.

The answer mentions all required facts: class type, instructor, starts at (date and time), capacity (whole number, default 12), and places left (capacity minus bookings). It states nothing contradicting the mustNot list, which is empty.

The answer says no email is sent when members book, which contradicts the required facts that members do get a mail when the booking is made. It also never mentions a reminder the day before. It fails the "yes", "a mail when the booking is made" and "a reminder the day before" requirements.
